author: ZelenskyyUa
text:
President Trump, our teams, and I spoke about how to end the war. This is the priority. We are ready. I’m not sure Russia is ready as of today, but anyhow, we spoke about an energy ceasefire. We are ready for an energy ceasefire if they do not attack our energy system, our electricity, heating, and water supply. This is our proposal. We are thankful to the American side. They will share it with the Russians. I don’t know the Russian position.

Tomorrow, President Trump will have a meeting with the leader of China. I said to the President, very openly, that we think if he also engages President Xi – he has influence on Putin. If we want to end this war, not just in messages, we all have to work 24/7 for this, for the people.

We also spoke about winter. It’s important on the way to negotiations. We have to prepare. It won’t be simple. We’re asking for two things from the American side. The first is a winter package of Patriot missiles. The second is licenses to produce Patriots. We also need security guarantees for Ukraine.

I think the most important move President Trump can make – he can organize a trilateral meeting where the leaders can raise all the sensitive issues and try to end the war.

From a conversation with the media.
